ns2:section.sectionText: This course will survey primary literature dealing with the psychological underpinnings of reading. Some topics to be included are the eye movements during reading, visual word recognition, syntactic parsing, syntactic and lexical ambiguity resolution, discourse processing, reading instruction, and reading in non-alphabetic orthographies. NOTE: Instructor will arrange meeting times with enrolled students.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to PHD:Educational Psych - UIUC.
